data.name: Command_Description_Close
data.value:
Closes a topic.
Unless specified otherwise, the command must be used within the topic itself. The version without arguments will not close the topic unless a title has been previously set using the command "#header value". Calling the command with "/close true" will close the topic even if it lacks a title. If the command is called with a text argument before closing the topic, it will assign the specified argument as the topic title; a call with a numerical argument allows closing any topic by its number.

data.name: Command_Description_Tag
data.value: When executed without arguments, the command responds with a list of tags set for the topic. By specifying the tag name as the first argument and its value as the second, the bot will set a new tag or overwrite an existing one for the topic in which the command is invoked. The three-argument version of the command explicitly accepts the topic number as the first argument, the tag name as the second, and the tag value as the third. Using the "header" tag key, the bot will set the topic description. This command has a shortened hash syntax: "#tag_name tag_value." The hash syntax doesn't allow spaces in the tag name, but it doesn't require quotation marks around the tag value if it contains spaces.

data.name: Command_Description_TagRemove
data.value: Removes the tag specified by the string argument. The single-argument option must be used in a user-specific topic; the numeric argument option allows you to explicitly specify the topic number.

data.value: When used in the novice's topic, it removes the assignment from you. The novice's mentor must invoke this command for the novice. If the topic was not assigned to the novice who dropped it, a penalty is applied to the queue.

data.name: Command_Description_Intercept
data.value: If entered in the novice's topic, it starts a vote to reassign the topic from the current assignee to you. If started less than 8 hours after the last message, 2 votes are required; otherwise, one. Voting stops if the assignee replies to the novice's message. In case of successful reassignment, a penalty is applied to the previous assignee in the queue.
